verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's docs describe a ready-to-use checkout that redirects customers to a payment page hosted by Mercado Pago (Checkout Pro), so developers don't build their own payment UI. Checkout Pro also documents guest payment without an account, a return URL after approval, 3DS 2.0, configurable payment methods, button styling, and webhook/IPN notifications. Missing for 10: explicit evidence the hosted page is conversion-optimized (e.g., conversion metrics or optimization claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the redirect checkout.
